title: ai-changelog-writer
offersHint: Cloudflare Workers MCP server: ai-changelog-writer · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://api.lazy-mac.com/ai-changelog-writer/mcp

toolsPreview.name: generate_changelog
toolsPreview.description: Generate a Markdown changelog from a list of commit messages. Supports conventional commits and heuristic classification.

toolsPreview.name: format_release_notes
toolsPreview.description: Format polished release notes for a given version, suitable for GitHub Releases or a product changelog page.

toolsPreview.name: generate_pr_description
toolsPreview.description: Generate a pull request description with summary, change stats, and a test checklist.

toolsPreview.name: summarize_commits
toolsPreview.description: Produce a short natural-language summary and structured breakdown of a set of commits.

toolsPreview.name: detect_breaking_changes
toolsPreview.description: Detect breaking changes from commit messages and/or a git diff. Returns a list of breaking items and a version-bump recommendation.
